items.claim: Jan Blachowicz has slowed down enough physically due to his age.
items.quote: Jan is slowed down enough for Navajo to just be a little bit ahead the entire fight.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is well prepared at CKB under Eugene Berman and fights effectively behind his jab and right hand.
items.quote: Eugene Berman does a great job at CKB. They're going to come in prepared, fight behind the jab, let the right hand go

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz does not get his leg up to check kicks as fast as he used to.
items.quote: Even though Jan does a good job checking kicks, he doesn't get the leg up there as fast anymore.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is almost 40 years of age.
items.quote: Daniel Rodriguez is a grizzled vet who's almost 40 years of age

items.claim: Uros Medic is in the prime of his career and will be much faster than Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: Yuros Medi is in the prime of his career and is one of the most dangerous strikers at 170 pounds... I think he's just going to be so much faster than D-Rod
